INTENTIONAL_SAFETY.behavior: Only non-#901 titles starting exactly [DEVWORKER READY] are eligible.
Pretty/multiline JSON objects parse; malformed JSON, invalid escapes, and non-objects reject.
SHELL requires a non-empty allowed argv list during contract validation, before any handler/model invocation.
git-managed CODEX requires git_delivery_owner=DEVWORKER before model execution.
Managed contract reports multiple deterministic field errors in one pass.
SHELL/QA accepts only listed executable basenames and limited git subcommands.
SHELL clean and dirty-readonly fingerprint paths are distinct; managed CODEX validates an exact 40-character base before staging.
Managed delivery retry uses the same staging output and does not rerun Codex in the delivery exception path.
poll_work_results returns 0 and post_terminal_event returns DISABLED_MANUAL_CHAT before active Work/event behavior.

CURRENT_COMPATIBILITY.behavior: delivery_policy=exact with non-empty delivery_roots uses reconciliation scope and may publish actual in-root paths.
Accepted managed model success emits implementation SUCCESS while QA remains UNKNOWN; delivery success is separately represented.
Issue state labels are projected by replacing [DEVWORKER READY] with RUNNING, event, or ERROR; snapshot-only in M0.
staging_changed_and_untracked_paths strips line-oriented git output; publisher has the stronger temporary-index whitespace check.
